items.title: EMPS — Enterprise Money Platform System
items.subtitle: Enterprise FinTech & Distributed Systems
items.summary: An enterprise financial platform built on distributed microservices, supporting money remittance, currency exchange, and online and offline financial services.
items.description: EMPS is an enterprise financial platform designed to support a wide range of financial operations, including money remittance, currency exchange, accounting, and online and offline financial services. Developed at MIS, the platform comprises over 20 microservices and supports operations across more than 300 branches in Syria. As part of a Scrum engineering team, I contributed to multiple financial domains while taking primary development responsibility for several business-critical modules.
challenges: Maintaining financial data consistency across distributed services and concurrent operations.
Modeling complex financial domains and business-critical transaction workflows.
Ensuring reliable asynchronous communication between independently deployed microservices.
Designing extensible components capable of accommodating evolving financial business requirements.
Automating recurring financial operations across multiple services.
contributions: Took primary development responsibility for online financial services, invoice exchange, and recurring job functionality.
Contributed to the development and maintenance of financial microservices using .NET and ABP Framework.
Implemented financial domain logic following Domain-Driven Design and Clean Architecture principles.
Applied optimistic concurrency control using timestamp-based concurrency tokens to protect against conflicting updates.
Implemented Inbox and Outbox patterns to improve the reliability of asynchronous service communication.
Designed plugin-based components to support extensibility and reduce coupling.
Developed automated financial workflows and recurring background jobs using Hangfire.
Contributed to accounting ledger, trading ledger, and balance tracking functionality.
outcomes: Delivered business-critical financial functionality within an enterprise distributed platform.
Supported reliable financial operations through concurrency protection and resilient messaging patterns.
Enabled extensible financial functionality through plugin-based design.
Automated recurring financial workflows, reducing the need for manual execution.

items.title: FutureGym
items.subtitle: Fitness Management Platform
items.summary: A multi-role fitness management platform supporting gym operations, subscription management, workout scheduling, and trainee progress tracking.
items.description: A production cross-platform fitness management application connecting gym administrators, trainers, and trainees within a unified platform. Developed during my time at E-solution groups, I was responsible for the entire backend, including database design, business logic, REST APIs, and administrative tools.
challenges: Modeling relationships between gyms, trainers, trainees, and workout schedules.
Managing authorization and access permissions across multiple user roles.
Designing subscription plans with feature-based access entitlements for gym administrators.
Supporting manual invoice-based payments within the subscription lifecycle.
contributions: Designed and developed the entire backend using Laravel and MySQL.
Built REST APIs supporting the cross-platform Flutter application.
Implemented subscription management with configurable plans and feature-based access.
Developed role-based authorization for administrators, trainers, and trainees.
Implemented gym management, workout scheduling, and trainee progress tracking.
Built a centralized administrative dashboard using Filament.
outcomes: Successfully delivered a production-ready backend supporting iOS and Android applications.
Unified gym administration, training management, and trainee workflows within a single platform.
Enabled subscription-based access to platform features for gym administrators.
Delivered centralized administrative tools for managing platform operations.

items.title: Dr. Calories
items.subtitle: Nutrition & Wellness Management Platform
items.summary: A nutrition management platform supporting personalized meal planning, dynamic dietary requests, and client wellness management.
items.description: A cross-platform nutrition and wellness application designed to streamline the management of personalized dietary programs. Developed during my time at E-solution groups, I was responsible for backend development during the initial development phase, focusing on dietary workflows, meal construction, business logic, and administrative tools.
challenges: Designing flexible dietary request models supporting different request types and varying client requirements.
Managing dynamic food preferences and dietary restrictions within personalized meal plans.
Modeling relationships between food items, nutritional values, meal plans, and client requests.
Supporting nutritional calculations during meal plan construction.
contributions: Designed and developed backend functionality using Laravel and MySQL.
Implemented flexible dietary request workflows supporting multiple request types.
Developed meal construction functionality with aggregated nutritional values and reusable meal plan templates.
Implemented personalized food preferences and dietary requirements.
Developed administrative tools using Filament for managing clients, food items, and dietary programs.
Built REST APIs and integrated Firebase notifications.
outcomes: Established the backend foundation for personalized nutrition management.
Enabled administrators to construct customized meal plans based on client requests and nutritional requirements.

items.title: Sama Art

Implementing complex animations while preserving a consistent user experience.
Resolving browser-specific rendering and CSS compatibility issues, particularly in Safari.
Maintaining responsive layouts across both Arabic and English interfaces.
contributions: Collaborated on the development of the corporate website and its dynamic frontend.
Implemented interactive animations and visual transitions throughout the website.
Handled the majority of mobile responsiveness and layout adaptations.
Resolved cross-browser compatibility issues across Chrome and Safari.
Refined frontend components to meet precise client design requirements.
outcomes: Contributed to the delivery of a live, bilingual corporate platform.
Delivered responsive and visually consistent interfaces across desktop and mobile devices.

about.title: Engineering Beyond the Code
about.introduction: For me, software engineering is more than writing code. It's about understanding complex problems, making thoughtful decisions, and building systems that remain reliable as they grow.

sections.title: How I Think
sections.description: I enjoy breaking down complex problems, understanding how systems behave under pressure, and finding practical solutions. I'm particularly interested in the challenges of concurrency, distributed systems, and data consistency.

sections.title: What Drives Me
sections.description: Curiosity keeps me learning. I like exploring new technologies, questioning architectural decisions, and turning ideas into working projects. Every experiment is an opportunity to become a better engineer.

sections.title: Beyond Engineering
sections.description: My long-term ambition is to build software products of my own. I'm interested in turning real problems into useful products, combining technical engineering with product thinking and entrepreneurship.
